split_reconstruction.primary: paper70: shuffled, unstratified 70/30 on KDDTrain+; seed 42 reference
split_reconstruction.evidence: Figure 3 totals 37792 (20083 normal, 17709 attack); standard KDDTrain+ with test_size=.30, random_state=42, stratify=None matches both class margins
split_reconstruction.limitation: Paper also states 75/25 and calls 125973/22544 a 75/25 split; author indices and code not provided

preprocessing: Training-only imputation, numeric min-max, categorical one-hot; difficulty excluded

feature_selection.documented: RF 300 trees, random_state=100, threshold=.05, reports nine features
feature_selection.encoded_threshold: Literal post-encoding threshold interpretation; actual selected count is reported
feature_selection.group_top9: Controlled group-aware alternative; exactly nine raw features, all their dummies retained
feature_selection.limitation: Nine selected names and whether importances refer to raw or encoded features are not specified

baseline_parameters.SVM: SVC linear, C=10; seed varies; paper reference seed=42; gamma irrelevant for linear kernel
baseline_parameters.LR: Uniform class weights, max_iter=100, threshold=.5; C=1, lbfgs and tolerance are reconstruction assumptions
baseline_parameters.KNN: k=5, Euclidean, uniform weights; paper mentions 30 iterations, which is not a KNeighborsClassifier parameter
baseline_parameters.unspecified: Other classifier/selector settings use recorded sklearn defaults, including RF criterion=gini; these are reconstruction assumptions

cross_validation: Paper mentions ten-fold CV without sufficient split/results detail; default five-fold OOF here constructs stacking, not a claimed reproduction of that CV
claims: Direct empirical comparison is against rerun baselines on identical saved cases; historical 98.24% is contextual, not a paired test or exact reproduction target
